required_preservation.provenance_refs: carry provider admission, provider trace, evidence trace, frame/source, gateway trace, context trace, field event trace, reducer trace where applicable
required_preservation.trace_refs: retain reverse path from Current World candidate to Context, Field Event, Observation, Visual Evidence, Provider, Frame and Model Manager admission
required_preservation.temporal_refs: carry evidence temporal_ref, observed_at, valid_from/valid_until candidates, event occurred/observed/received timestamps and reducer temporal snapshot
required_preservation.uncertainty_refs: carry VisualDetection uncertainty_refs through gateway, observation, Context and Current World candidates
required_preservation.contradiction_refs: carry evidence contradiction_refs and gateway/field conflict lineage without collapsing disagreement
required_preservation.correction_refs: preserve user/owner correction lineage and supersession/revocation references

authority_rule: provenance and trace enable auditability but never grant truth or mutation authority
